_comment_csp_script_hashes: The 3 sha256- entries in script-src below are exact hashes of index.html's 3 inline <script> blocks (the small theme-manifest snippet near the top, the main app logic, and the search-sync snippet near the end). If ANY of their content changes - even one character - the browser will silently block that script and the hash must be recomputed, or the affected feature breaks with no visible error beyond the browser console. External <script src=...> tags are unaffected; they're already governed by the https:// hosts listed, not by these hashes.
buildCommand: npm run build && cp index.html public/index.html && cp sw.js public/sw.js
